value: U.S. Department of Energy, Advanced Manufacturing Office; prepared by Energetics Incorporated (2014). 2010 Manufacturing Energy and Carbon Footprints: Scope. Companion document to the 2010 MECS Manufacturing Energy and Carbon Footprints (February 2014), 5 pp.

Methodology companion to the 2010 MECS footprint diagrams (doe_2014_001); no technology parameters. Sectors covered and their NAICS definitions, with their share of manufacturing energy and GHG.
